name: the robot dog
description: ESP32 quadruped. walk_forward and demo_mode physically move it, so they require a spoken yes before dispatch.

capabilities.name: sit
capabilities.description: Make the robot dog sit down. Harmless, stationary.

capabilities.name: stand
capabilities.description: Make the robot dog stand up from sitting. Harmless, stationary.

capabilities.name: walk_forward
capabilities.description: Walk the robot dog forward a number of steps. It PHYSICALLY MOVES - confirm intent before calling.

capabilities.name: turn
capabilities.description: Turn the robot dog in place.

capabilities.name: demo_mode
capabilities.description: Run the full movement demo routine. It PHYSICALLY MOVES around - confirm intent before calling.
